title: Odd-function Fourier term as a subset average
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta$ be real, and let $f$ be an odd real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. For every set of coordinates $S$,
\[
\widehat f(S)^2\sum_{J\subseteq S} (-(1-\delta))^{|J|}(-\delta)^{|S|-|J|}\widehat f(J)
=\widehat f(S)^2\,\mathbb E_K\!\left[(-1)^{|S\cap K|}\widehat f(S\cap K)\right],
\]
where $\widehat f$ denotes the Fourier coefficient and $K$ is sampled with the subset weights at parameter $1-\delta$.
